text_block_list.text:
A few days after meeting Daring Heart…… 
Before I realized it, I would find myself following her with my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Heart, you're eating by yourself again! 
……Wawah! Aren't you eating more than before……!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now I'm bulking up——building my strength. For the next 
mock race, I need to get this body in to perfect shape.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend D
text_block_list.text:
Mock race…… that one with Rhein Kraft! 
I heard she was strong～. But for Heart it's a piece of cake♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No. Kraft, Cesario, and Messiah. They have great potential. 
I absolutely…… can't take them lightly.

Rhein Kraft, Cesario, and Air Messiah——Strong Uma Musume that 
are competing against Daring Heart in the Tiara rotation.

Of course, Daring Heart has potential too. But still, 
if there was one thing where she was a step behind, it would be——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
But where I lose to them is——physique. 
To win in competition, increasing physical strength is important.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So for now, the solo lunches will continue. 
Once things calm down, let's eat lunch together again♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Ugh…… so much……

The food was piled up on her plate, much more than 
someone of her slender frame would normally consume. 
It looked like she was trying to force it all down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I can do this……——I can keep going……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
…… ……Phew…… ate it all. 
——……Oh? Hey!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that I wanted to see you again! After this, how 
about spending some time together? I'd like your help with something♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fuu……! Fuu……! ……Fuu——……!

『If you notice anything, please let me know』—— 
After she said that, I was now watching over her training.

The weights she was using were heavier than I 
expected. Considering her physique, it seemed like 
she was putting considerable strain on herself.

Her form was starting to crumble. At this rate, 
the results would be unsatisfactory. Aside from 
that, there was the risk of injury. I spoke up.
choice_data_list: It's about time for a break

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No, not yet…… I can keep going……! 
Maybe 2 more sets……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (…………That's right…… I didn't even notice——……)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
…………I understand. Maybe I'm just a little on 
edge right now…… Thanks for letting me know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're pretty good at judging the situation rationally—— 
Fufu, you're quite the outstanding trainer, aren't you? 
……That's right, what about your trainee?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? But…… that's kind of unexpected. 
So you're just getting started too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right…… your Trainer life, and my road to being Queen, 
it all starts now. Ohhh…… it's kind of exciting, don't you think!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes, my aim is the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Watching Japan's Triple Tiara races…… 
I made a firm vow. That I too would wear that floral crown!

The Triple Tiara——a title bestowed upon one who 
obtained victory in three specific Classic-grade 
races. The 『Oka Sho』, 『Oaks』, and 『Shuuka Sho』

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……Soon I'll be running a mock race with some of the 
girls that will also be competing for the Tiara. The 
first time on stage with my fated rivals. ——Which is why——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Being able to train for even a second longer, 
being able to lift even one more gram. Nutrition, 
lifestyle, all of it for the sake of victory!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And then, without fail, I will become a Triple Tiara Queen——!

She spoke of it, not like a dream…… but as if it were the future. 
——I was deeply moved by her strong determination.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, this seems like a good stopping point, 
let's call it a day. You're quite a good listener…… 
So I ended up getting a little carried away!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go for a run outside. 
Sorry, but could you get my bag?

As I grabbed her bag, my eyes fell on 
the schedule book she had left lying open.

It was a schedule with no breaks at all. She filled absolutely 
every minute——like this, she would only be wearing herself down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Aaah…… about my schedule? Fufuu, you're quite the worrywart, huh. 
But it's fine. I'm really tough, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
——For the sake of victory. To go further than anyone, I need 
to work harder than anyone. Without stopping, without stumbling—— 
Even if I have to crawl, I will keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's from a disadvantage, or is reckless——I'll overcome 
it all. This "Daring Heart" will carry through to victory!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To become my 『Best Self』, 
I can't stand still. ……Not even for a second.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll become a great trainer. You're this 
kind after all. Maybe…… a little too kind to me.

That firm, unwavering, and directed 
conviction would drive her ever forward.

She is strong. In her heart, her gaze, and her 
conviction. For an Uma Musume that was this 
strong…… perhaps someone like me was unnecessary.

There was just no room for error. If she continued on 
like this…… would her body, her mind, be able to keep up?
Someday…… that could all crumble……

If something like that happened, to see 
that "Daring Heart" be brought low——

So that doesn't happen, I need to throw my Heart in 
to this too. ——I'll prepare the only weapon I have.
